name: Grid<T>
src_typeComment: Plain 2D array with cell<->local-space coordinate conversion baked in. Not a MonoBehaviour and not tied to a world plane on purpose — GridComponent wraps this and decides whether it maps to XZ (3D ground plane) or XY (2D) world space, so this class stays reusable for either.

src_members.sig: public Grid(int width, int height, float cellSize)
src_members.name: Grid

src_members.sig: public bool IsValidCell(int x, int y) => x >= 0 && x < Width && y >= 0 && y < Height
src_members.name: IsValidCell

src_members.sig: public T GetValue(int x, int y) => IsValidCell(x, y) ? cells[x, y] : default
src_members.name: GetValue

src_members.sig: public void SetValue(int x, int y, T value)
src_members.name: SetValue

src_members.sig: public Vector2 CellToLocal(int x, int y) => new Vector2(x * CellSize, y * CellSize)
src_members.name: CellToLocal
src_members.comment: Local offset (in world units, before the grid's own transform is applied) of a cell's bottom-left corner.

src_members.sig: public Vector2 CellToLocalCenter(int x, int y) => CellToLocal(x, y) + Vector2.one * (CellSize * 0.5f)
src_members.name: CellToLocalCenter
src_members.comment: Local offset of a cell's center — usually what you want when snapping an object into the cell.

src_members.sig: public void LocalToCell(Vector2 local, out int x, out int y)
src_members.name: LocalToCell
